transcript: One of my favorite theater experiences is back in new york, burn out paradise. Burn out paradise was an edinburgh fringe darling in twenty twenty four. Came to saint ann's last year. I know it sounds deeply silly. It is an australian group called pony cam and they're amazing. It's just so much fun and I cannot wait to see it again. The thing that makes burnout paradise so compelling is that it is chaos, but it also has very specific rules. There are four treadmills and each has a very specific task. Survival, make a three course meal from scratch. Admin, complete a grant proposal. Performance, do some sort of performance. And leisure is completing a series of tasks on a whiteboard. Almost all of them require help from the audience, although it is not mandatory and the level of participation required is very wide ranging. Like this one, the audience member had to go duck hunting. And these are the volunteers eating the three course meal. I drank gatorade this time. And every twelve minutes a timer goes off and the performers switch treadmills. They also have to run a certain amount of mileage while doing their tasks. It's very exciting. So all four performers are on all four treadmills by The end of the night and everything gets progressively more chaotic. If you love the show taskmaster, you will love this show. But it's just such a fun night. And the more you put into it, the more you will definitely get out of it. At the end of the night, the goal is they accomplish all their tasks and run the mileage goal. And on our night we did just that. And by we, I mean they. They did it. I definitely felt very accomplished though. Burn out paradise is currently playing at the astor place theater. It's under eighty minutes. Bring friends who like to have a good time and we talking about this one forever.
